name: Largest Strongly Shattered Set / co-VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the whole domain is a contained $n$-cube, so $\mathrm{ST}=n$, while $\mathrm{coVC}=0$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For common-core singletons $\mathcal C^{\cap}_n=\{\{0,i\}:1\leq i\leq n\}$, $\mathrm{coVC}=n$ after projecting away the common coordinate, while $\mathrm{ST}=0$.
proof: The two explicit families give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
references: Database-owned value proofs for the Full Cube and Common-Core Singletons.
